decisions.reason: The expanded asset package supports future editing but does not change the existing self-service PDF export capability or workflow.
Adding logos, colour codes, and other design assets does not change which customer-specific fields must be editable or their formatting.
The Canva format, editability, and required variants are independently established by the same message; the asset-package contents do not modify those attributes.
The asset-package expansion does not change the separately stated PDF deliverable format or required report variants.
The source requests Canva templates, PDFs, and supporting assets but does not explicitly alter or remove the historically delivered Word documents.
The source repeats the existing DX17–DX20 set but does not change its variant codes, editability, or risk-based selection rule.
The contents of the reusable design-asset package do not change the scoring table format or required scoring fields.
Providing reusable visual assets does not change the established visual standard, reference, cross-variant theme, or finish priorities.
The asset-package contents do not alter the required front-page result drivers, their presentation format, or detail level.
The expanded delivery assets do not change the front-page result fields, score heading, prominence, spacing, or visibility.
The asset-package modification does not change the coverage, presentation, or text of internal-page headers.
The expanded asset package has no necessary effect on footer presence, content, or page coverage.
